title: Qualified automatic cut resets saved selection before each real toggle
expected: With stable conditions, manual cycling traverses all four eligible images and wraps: initial B, then C, D, A, B.
actual: Native engine confirmed initial B, then C, B, C, B: selected IDs 10002|10003|10002|10003|10002. A and D cannot be displayed through the real toggle control. Both one-rule and two-rule fixtures reproduce the failure.

nativeEvidence.execution: Original jo9_html followed by four original jo9_toggle calls in root-owned isolated native fixtures

releaseScope: Confirmed regression in the latest WORK appearance-condition feature. The intentionally unsynchronized latest Kor_Full does not contain this feature; this finding is not a claim that every release is blocked.
rootCause: jo9_toggle captures saved selection, then calls jo9_path without mode (numeric zero). The new SELECT hook forces the lowest qualifying cut. When saved C differs from forced B, jo9_toggle skips its mode1 call and replaces C with B. Pure mode1 tests do not execute this path.
proposedFixOnly: Have manual toggle normalize/filter its saved candidate without applying the automatic mode0 preference, then cycle among eligible active paths; retain automatic lowest-cut preference when a scene is freshly rendered. Keep mode2's already-rendered path identification and existing saved IDs intact. Add repeated real jo9_toggle regression cases with 3+ active paths, one configured cut, multiple matching cuts, and conditions changing. No production code has been edited.
